name: browser-use
headline: Claude code plugin for fast coding tasks
short_description: carter-marketplace with claude code plugin to speed up coding tasks. handy tools include subagents, mcp, skills, command.
author: bjzgcai

sections.overview:
Carter Marketplace provides a curated collection of production-ready Claude Code plugins designed to supercharge development workflows. It includes specialized agents like code-review and chrome-devtools for complex multi-step tasks, creative skills such as frontend-design for building distinctive interfaces, efficient commands like /commit for git automation, and MCP server integrations for external tools. Each plugin works out of the box with minimal configuration, solving real development problems through autonomous sub-processes, domain-specific capabilities, and lightweight operations. Developers benefit from pre-configured tools that handle code quality analysis, security audits, browser debugging, and frontend development without manual setup.
Performing automated code reviews with security and performance analysis
Real-time frontend debugging using Chrome DevTools in live browsers
Creating production-grade, distinctive web interfaces and components
Automating git commits following Angular convention
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/bjzgcai/carter-marketplace`
sections.usage:
```
I'm working on a project for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. I need to automate [SPECIFIC TASK] using the carter-marketplace plugin. Can you help me with this? I have [DATA] available to work with. Please use subagents, MCP, skills, or command tools as needed.
```
Copy

```
```python
# Carter Marketplace Automation Script
# Company: GreenTech Solutions
# Industry: Renewable Energy
# Task: Automate customer data processing

import carter_marketplace as cm

# Initialize subagents
agent1 = cm.SubAgent('data_processor')
agent2 = cm.SubAgent('report_generator')

# Use MCP for data processing
processed_data = cm.MCP.process([DATA], agent1)

# Generate report using skills
report = cm.Skills.generate_report(processed_data, agent2)

# Execute command to save report
cm.Command.execute('save_report', report)
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
